title: Ostomy Supply Program Item Allowance and Eligibility Schedule
content:
The Ostomy Supply Program covers barriers, pouches and accessories within a monthly allowance per item and only for the items that suit the program's appliance system and ostomy type. Quantities are counted in billing units: each barrier, pouch, belt or bedside drainage bag is one unit, and paste and adhesive remover are counted per ounce.

## Monthly allowance by item (billing units per 30 days of supply on one program)

Columns: SP = Ostomy Self-Pay Program, HMO = Ostomy Commercial HMO Program, PPO = Ostomy Commercial PPO Program, MA = Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program, OM = Ostomy Original Medicare Program, MCD = Ostomy Medicaid Program.

| Item | Description | SP | HMO | PPO | MA | OM | MCD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A4414 | Flat skin barrier with flange 4x4 in or smaller | 20 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| A4407 | Extended-wear skin barrier with built-in convexity | 20 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 10 |
| A4409 | Extended-wear flat skin barrier | 20 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 10 |
| A4416 | One-piece closed pouch with filter | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| A4423 | Two-piece closed pouch for a locking-flange barrier | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| A4424 | One-piece drainable pouch | 20 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| A4427 | Two-piece drainable pouch | 20 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| A4431 | One-piece urinary pouch with tap | 20 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| A4434 | Two-piece urinary pouch with tap | 20 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| A4406 | Pectin-based paste, per ounce | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| A4455 | Adhesive remover, per ounce | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| A4367 | Ostomy belt | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| A4357 | Bedside drainage bag | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

The accessories A4406 (paste), A4455 (adhesive remover) and A4367 (ostomy belt) are counted per customer, not per program: their allowance is counted once per customer across all of the customer's ostomy programs, on every tier.

## Items each program may receive

The barrier and pouch items a program may receive depend on its appliance system and ostomy type, and are the same on every tier. Accessories are eligible for every program.

| Appliance system | Colostomy | Ileostomy | Urostomy |
|---|---|---|---|
| One-piece | A4416, A4424 | A4424 | A4431, A4357 |
| Two-piece | A4414, A4407, A4409, A4423, A4427 | A4414, A4407, A4409, A4427 | A4414, A4407, A4409, A4434, A4357 |

## Documentation terms by tier

- **Convex barrier documentation** - whether a barrier with built-in convexity (A4407) is covered only with a practitioner record documenting a flush or retracted stoma.
- **Over-limit record age** - a quantity above the monthly allowance is covered only with a practitioner record of the clinical reason (high output, leakage, peristomal skin breakdown) dated within this many calendar months before the ship date; 0 means no above-allowance coverage.
- **Sample kits** - the no-charge manufacturer sample kits Larkfield may send per program over the rolling 12 months ending on the sample ship date.

| Tier | Convex barrier documentation required | Over-limit record age | Sample kits per 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | No | 0 (no above-allowance coverage) | 3 |
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program | Yes | 6 months | 2 |
| Ostomy Commercial PPO Program | No | 6 months | 2 |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | Yes | 6 months | 2 |
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | No | 6 months | 2 |
| Ostomy Medicaid Program | Yes | 6 months | 2 |

## Reading the schedule

- The convex barrier A4407 has an allowance of 20 per 30 days on the Self-Pay, Commercial PPO, Medicare Advantage and Original Medicare tiers, 15 on the Commercial HMO tier and 10 on the Medicaid tier.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a two-piece colostomy program may receive A4414, A4407, A4409, A4423 and A4427 plus the accessories, but never the one-piece pouches A4416 or A4424.
